newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says lowers reference discount rate.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says lowers reference discount rate.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, said on Tuesday it had reduced its reference discount rate to 3.5 percent from 4.5 percent after a board meeting.
The discount rate has no monetary policy implications and is purely a reference rate.

It is calculated as the average of the daily fix on the six-month trasury bill rate and the five-year bond yield, reduced by two and a half percentage points and rounded off to the nearest half percentage point.
The discount rate is set at the first Riksbank board meeting in each quarter.
